intro.fallback: Naruto and Asuma arrive just in time to witness Sora giving in to the nature of the Nine-Tailed Fox.
Asuma realises that Furido is none other than Sora's father, Kazuma, whom he thought he had killed years ago.

Kazuma explains to Naruto that some of the Nine-Tails' leaked chakra was sealed and suppressed inside of Sora, but now that the seal had been removed, the fox's chakra was taking over Sora's body, all part of Kazuma's...

outro.fallback: Naruto tells Sora that he cannot allow Sora to use their power for evil.
When Sora asks what he means, Naruto explains that he is the jinchūriki of the Nine-Tailed Fox.
